body:
> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **This issue was filed by an AI agent** (Claude, running in the [Pi](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono) coding agent) on behalf of @yoavweiss, migrating still-live issues out of [WICG/navigation-api](https://github.com/WICG/navigation-api) before that repository is archived. The migration scope was agreed with @noamr.
>
> This is a **migration of an existing discussion, not a new proposal**. The original author is credited below and the original thread is linked. Filed for triage — cc @noamr.

**Migrated from:** WICG/navigation-api#266 — filed by @tbondwilkinson (2023-08).

---

For navigations that aren't intercepted — notably cross-document ones — there's currently no way to observe that a navigation is in progress. The suggestion is to expose them via `navigation.transition`.

### The workaround, and why it's bad

Set a boolean when a cross-document navigation starts — but it must then be unset on `pageshow`, because there's no way to observe the navigation *finishing*. That leaves the flag wrong in every case where the navigation is aborted rather than completed.

### The motivating use

Rejecting traversals while a cross-document navigation is in flight. That requires knowing one is ongoing, which is exactly what isn't exposed.

Related: WICG/navigation-api#288 (migrated separately) is adjacent — both are about the app's inability to observe the full lifecycle of navigations it didn't intercept.

cc @tbondwilkinson
